A few things I still remember, mom.

🌿tap

Remember the time you caught me walking for the first time? If that day didn't exist, I wouldn't walk.

🍃tap

Remember the first time I went to school? If I didn't, I wouldn't know how toxic society is.

🌱tap

Remember the first time I cried because I had less? If I didn't learn that then, how would I live in the present and future?

🌿tap

But what has made me learn all this? You, Mom. If I didn't have you, I wouldn't be in this world. Not able to do merit? Not learn how to live? Or probably die as another animal? Or even get hurt or tortured from a toxic family somewhere?

So Mom, thank you for all you did.

Now remember the times? All the time, who was with me?
